### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**28** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8afaf12d7c302072871f7e975e9dff5be5541d90`.

⛔ **7** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **173** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8afaf12d7c302072871f7e975e9dff5be5541d90` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `ede30e99a53cb36bfc452fb1a7d24430c89a6af5` — the merge of head `fb7fafd3d3e4b4c49b15955ce00c5f17323bdcb5` into base `8afaf12d7c302072871f7e975e9dff5be5541d90`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin ede30e99a53cb36bfc452fb1a7d24430c89a6af5 && git checkout ede30e99a53cb36bfc452fb1a7d24430c89a6af5
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8afaf12d7c302072871f7e975e9dff5be5541d90 fb7fafd3d3e4b4c49b15955ce00c5f17323bdcb5 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8afaf12d7c302072871f7e975e9dff5be5541d90 && git merge --no-ff fb7fafd3d3e4b4c49b15955ce00c5f17323bdcb5

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8afaf12d7c302072871f7e975e9dff5be5541d90
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8afaf12d7c302072871f7e975e9dff5be5541d90` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7edbf44b9d7d6cd13699f7c65e03230b1a4f9ec3`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts + packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts (`readPackageCustomizations`, `readBaseContributions`), packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-customizations.test.ts (the pin), packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`getAllObjects`, `getObjectContributors`, `getObjectOwner`, `registerObject` extend path, `listItems`, `getPackagedObjectBase`), packages/objectql/src/engine.ts (`objectExtensions` registration at 9021, `stampPackage`), packages/metadata-core/src/code-artifact-provenance.ts (`isCodeArtifactBody`), packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts (the start node's `config.objectName`, 3715 / 6046), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/packageCustomizations-io.ts (first consumer), .changeset/28722-customizations-contributions.md, packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json, packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts

Head `7edbf44b` is one commit on `b4a36765` (the brief's head) and touches only the changeset; the net diff against `origin/main` at merge-base `4bf48a8c` is 12 files, +254/−17 code plus the 3-line changeset correction. Inputs: card #28722 (body, triage `6560179406`, claim `6560204697`, os-dev-report `6561138282`), PR #28749 body (as patched by the seat on `7edbf44b`), file list, `git diff 4bf48a8c 7edbf44b`, and the check-runs on `7edbf44b`.

The remainder of the diff — content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx and docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/api.md (regenerated), packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.package-customizations-mount.test.ts and the three ui fixtures (the required member added to hand-built answers) — is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; it was read to judge the `hits` file, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Public surface, widened.** `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema` gains `contributions` (array of strict `{ kind: 'field' | 'flow', object, name, packageId }`) and `counts.contributions`, both REQUIRED, the object staying `.strict()`. Right: the answer's rule since N-15 (#28411) is "strict at every level, counts derived from the lists in the same answer"; an optional member would let `counts.contributions` and `contributions` disagree by absence. Consequence named right by the changeset: a client parsing through this spec version refuses an older server's answer — in this monorepo the ui reader (`packageCustomizations-io.ts`) and the runtime handler version together, and every hand-built answer in the tree that the strict parse reaches is updated (1 runtime mount test, 2 runtime handler equalities, 3 ui fixtures; `git grep` on the head finds no other).
- **Accept-set, unchanged.** The route's request side is untouched: `GetPackageCustomizationsRequestSchema`, the closed query set, the pair-id 400 and the 404 wording are as on `main`. Right — the PR claims no request change and makes none.
- **Authorable-surface shard** `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`: +1 row `api/GetPackageCustomizationsResponse:contributions`. Right as generated output; it is the ratchet's record that this is a metadata-protocol `added` (② below). `api-surface/api.json`, `declaration-map`, `export-origins`, `json-schema.manifest` are unmoved: no export added or removed — right, the member sits inside an existing export.
- **Strictness ledger** 474 → 475: one new `.strict()` site (the `contributions` entry object; `counts` was already strict). Right.
- **Route ledger** note for `GET /packages/:id/customizations` names the fourth list; row, disposition, client method and `responseSchema` unchanged. Right — no new route, no new mount, no client change (`packages/client` is not in the diff and needs none: `customizations()` returns the spec type by re-export).
- **Served semantics implied by the schema descriptions** and checked against the reader (④): field = an `extend` contributor's declared `fields` keys on a base-OWNED object, from any package but base and pair; flow = a registered flow whose `start` node `config.objectName` is base-owned, whose stamp is a code package's, from any package but base and pair; order object, kind, name, package. Each description matches what `readBaseContributions` does.
- **Nothing stamped at fold time** (`mergeObjectDefinitions` untouched, #28565's surface): right — the contributor list already holds the fact, and the write door and every object read are left alone.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/28722-customizations-contributions.md` at `7edbf44b`: `@objectstack/spec: minor`, `@objectstack/runtime: minor`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`. PR body (patched): the same three lines, plus `Skills-docs: none`.

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` — right: a new required member on a served answer, nothing taken away, no `(narrowing)` arm.
- `Metadata-protocol: added` / `minor` on both moved packages — right by the rule the gate prints (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3, maintainer ruling A 2026-10-21 on #25105): the diff moves `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, and a moved authorable-surface shard IS a key added, so the kind is `added` and every package the diff moves takes at least `minor`. Precedent on `main` agrees: #28451 (`cascadeDeleteObjects` on two responses), #28595 (this very route's answer) and #28440 (`PublicFormSubmitResponse`) each moved the shard and declared `added` / `minor`.
- The brief's head `b4a36765` declared `none` / `patch` on the dev's reading that "a response member is not authorable". The gate refused it (Check Changeset job 124917265918: "Moved: packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json … metadata-protocol `none`"), and the rule's text in the gate is explicit that the shard decides and is never edited to quiet it. The correction at `7edbf44b` is the right one and the only one.
- Check-runs on `7edbf44b`, `Check Changeset`: two runs. Job 124918186197 (run 41330100822, 17:10:26Z) **failure** — it read the PR body BEFORE the seat's patch (its log shows `metadata-protocol line: Metadata-protocol: none`); job 124918449519 (run 41330188343, 17:11:24Z → 17:13:12Z) **success** on the patched body with the `7edbf44b` changeset. The newer run is the gate's verdict on this head's declaration; the older is a verdict on the stale body.
- `Clause-②:` line: `yes (widening)` — matches the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

From the os-dev-report `6561138282` (a report on `b4a36765`; the seat's later message supersedes its declaration):

- `open_questions: []` — nothing to answer.
- `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, carrier #28572 (N-19): the ui reader of `contributions` (D5's greyed, attributed drawing) is N-19's, and N-19's in-flight hand-built answers must gain the required member once this lands. Answered: the triage (`6560179406`) allowed "a named ui card with the server key pinned by a test", and the key is pinned by `packages-customizations.test.ts` (#28722 describe block, 4 tests, whole-answer parse through the declared schema). The fixture cost on N-19 is real and named; it is the cost the PR body's "member vs new route" measurement accepted. No escalation.
- `out_of_scope_findings[1]`, carrier #27928: Wanted 3 (navigation entries) held for the ruling there; the PR is `Part of #28722` and the `kind` enum is closed to `field | flow`. Matches the triage's scope split. No escalation.
- `deviations`: "Expected `added` / `minor`, measured `none` / `patch`". This deviation was WRONG — the dev's measurement ("a response member is not authorable") contradicts the rule the gate enforces and the shard the diff moves; the order's expectation was right. Resolved at `7edbf44b` by the seat's correction; the report's `summary` and `deviations` text on this point is stale and superseded. Recorded here so the record, not the report, carries the ruling.
- `deviations`, fixture edits outside spec/runtime (4 hand-built answers): a consequence of the required strict member, each one a test file; right and complete (`git grep` on the head finds no other hand-built answer).
- `gates`: "ui app-shell type-check NOT MEASURED locally; CI covers". On `7edbf44b` `Type Check · source gates` is green; `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Test Core (1–8/8)`, `Lint · *` (except `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, green), `Build *` and `Live E2E UI` are still `in_progress` at 17:15Z. Their conclusions are the gate verdicts the brief names; this record does not pre-empt them — the lane seat reads them before landing.
- No dev flag asks for a maintainer ruling; nothing escalates.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` (`GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema`), judged against the ruling it implements (ADR-0029 D7 as amended by ADR-0146 D3: a contributed item, when its base is open in Studio, is drawn greyed with its source package named — ADR-0146 line 320: "flows watching its objects, fields extending its objects, ADR-0029 D7 navigation contributions"), the card's Wanted 1–2 and its fixture, and its first consumer (`packageCustomizations-io.ts`, strict parse; N-19 as the drawer). Reader read in the live tree.

**Holds — tried and not broken:**

1. **The source is named on the item, not joined by name.** Two packages adding `acme_sync_id` are two entries with their own `packageId` (pinned by test 2). The schema's `object` + `name` + `packageId` is the full identity of a contributed item; nothing on the client has to invent a source — the card's one hard rule.
2. **Field entries come from the one owner of the fact.** `registry.getObjectContributors(name)` holds every `extend` contributor with its `packageId` and its declared body (`registerObject`, extend branch: the contributor's `definition` is the body as given, `applyProtection` stamps provenance; `engine.ts` 9021 is the manifest door that builds `extDef` from `objectExtensions`). The reader walks `getAllObjects(baseId)` filtered to `getObjectOwner(name)?.packageId === baseId` — the same walk N-15 makes for the pair — so "base-owned object" is `ownership: 'own'`, never an overlay (`getObjectOwner` excludes overlays by its own docblock). Objects the base merely extends are not its surface: right under D7.
3. **Flow entries come from the registry's stamp and the spec's own trigger slot.** `_packageId` is `registerItem`'s stamp (engine.ts 4834–4927, #28534 guards). The trigger object is the `start` node's `config.objectName` — the one place the flow spec declares it (`flow.zod.ts` 1034–1044) and the one place the automation engine reads it (`service-automation/src/engine.ts` 3715, 6046) and the runtime authoring gate reads it (`runtime-authoring-gate.ts` 253). No second notion of "a flow on an object" is invented.
4. **Exclusions.** Base and pair are excluded by id on both kinds (`isContributor`); the pair's members stay in `extensions` and the "customized" count (`counts.overrides + counts.extensions`) the landing draws is unchanged — the first consumer's numbers do not move (its fixture test proves the fixture edit was the only edit needed).
5. **Disable.** `listItems('flow')` drops a disabled package's flows; the fold (`foldObjectExtendersOnto`, `resolveObject`) does NOT drop a disabled package's `extend` fields. The contributions list follows each served read exactly: a disabled package's fields are listed because the served object still carries them, its flows are not because the served flow list does not. Consistent with what Studio will draw beside; the schema says so for flows.
6. **Strictness and counts.** `contributions` entry `.strict()`, `counts.contributions` an int ≥ 0 derived from the list; the whole answer parses through the declared schema in the pinning test and in the mount test. The ui's strict parse (`packageCustomizations-io.ts` 73) is the consumer the required member is right for.
7. **Ordering** object, kind (field before flow), name, package — declared and implemented identically; deterministic for a drawer.
8. **Member of the N-15 read, not a new route.** The measurement in the PR body holds against the tree: the read gate, closed query set, pair refusal and 404 wording live in one handler; a new route would duplicate four things and add a ledger row, a mount, a client method and census pins. The cost (hand-built answers must carry the member) is paid in the diff.
9. **Wanted 3 left open without a hole.** `kind` is a closed enum `field | flow`; a `nav` kind later is a widening, and the entry shape (`object`, `name`, `packageId`) already fits a navigation entry on an app if #27928 rules for a served read.

**Findings:**

- **should-fix (④, `packages.ts` `readBaseContributions` vs the schema's `packageId` description):** the two kinds apply two different tests of "is this stamp a package's". The flow branch asks `isCodeArtifactBody(flow)` (drops the `sys_metadata` sentinel AND any `_provenance: 'org'` body); the field branch asks only `isContributor(packageId)` (non-empty, not base, not pair). An `extend` contributor's `definition` carries `_packageId` and `_provenance` too (registry.ts 543–546 and 3859–3863), and the registry's own packaged-base read already applies `isCodeArtifactBody(c.definition)` to `extend` contributors (registry.ts 5545). In the live tree every `extend` contributor enters through the manifest door (engine.ts 9021), so no witnessed case diverges today; but a tenant-built app (not the pair) whose rehydrated manifest extends a base object and ships a flow on it would have its field listed and its flow not. One rule for both kinds — `isCodeArtifactBody(contributor.definition)` on the field branch, mirroring the flow branch — keeps "a package's contribution" one predicate. Not a must-fix: no served case contradicts the schema's text today, and the pin (test 3) covers the flow side only.
- **should-fix (④, schema docblock, `hits` file):** the `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema` comment says "X's own items and the pair's (listed above) are never contributions". The pair's *extension members* are listed above; the pair's own flows on X's objects are listed nowhere in this answer (N-15's `overrides` holds the pair's overrides of X's items, not the pair's new flows). The exclusion is the card's ruling and is right; the parenthesis over-claims what is served. One clause — "the pair's extension members are listed above; its other items are the pair's own" — makes the docblock exact. Prose only; no served value changes.
- **should-fix (③/record hygiene, not the tree):** the os-dev-report `6561138282` still states `Metadata-protocol: none` / `patch` and a wrong `deviations` reading; the seat's correction supersedes it. A one-line follow-up on the card naming `7edbf44b` and the corrected kind keeps the card's ledger from carrying a refuted measurement as the last word.

No must-fix. The schema change holds against ADR-0029 D7 / ADR-0146 D3, the card's fixture is the test's fixture, the reader reads two registries that already record the contributor, and the first consumer parses the answer it is given.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · PR #28749 · 2026-11-01T17:58Z

Head-sha: `7edbf44b9d7d6cd13699f7c65e03230b1a4f9ec3`

**维护者速读(席位终稿)**
- **改了什么**:`GET /packages/:id/customizations` 的应答新增 `contributions`(及 `counts.contributions`):对一个已安装的基础包，列出其他包给它的对象加的扩展字段、以及挂在它对象上的流程，每条注明来源包。基础包自己与其 `<base>.custom` 配对包不计入。
- **为什么改**:#28722 的前两项。Studio 要把别的包带进来的字段和流程画成灰色并注明来源(ADR-0029 D7),此前没有任何已服务的读取能说清来源，客户端不许自行推断。第 3 项(导航条目)等 #27928 的裁决，本 PR 为 `Part of #28722`。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只在已有应答里加一个必填成员;请求侧不变;树内所有手写的该应答(1 个 runtime 挂载测试、2 个处理器断言、3 个 ui 夹具)已同步。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` 的新成员;`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的 `readBaseContributions`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-customizations.test.ts`(main 上红)。
- **需要你做的**:无。席位按常设授权落地;#28722 保持打开，等 #27928。
- **席位意见**:契约复核 PASS,可落。

### 核对六项
1. **形态**:draft → `main`;`Part of #28722`,合并不关卡(第 3 项留给 #27928),正确。文件 12 个，在认领 `6560204697` 申报面内(spec、runtime、ui 夹具、生成文件与 changeset)。
2. **前提实测**:dev 按卡片夹具(基础包 + 配对包 + 第三个包扩展一个字段、加一个流程)先红后绿，读取点名第三个包、不点名基础包与配对包;消融后红，恢复。
3. **门禁**:本 head check-runs 59 success、9 skipped(路径未命中)、0 待跑;唯一 failure 是 17:12Z 读旧正文的 `Check Changeset`,17:13Z 重读新正文 success。`Test UI (8/16)` 首跑红于 `ui/packages/fields` 的 `FilterConditionField.betweenBlankBound-9914`(期望数字 5、收到字符串 "5"),本 PR 未碰 `ui/`,判为无关抖动;重跑失败 job 一次(run 41330100857 第 2 次)全绿。dev 本地 109/109 派生门禁 exit 0,0 NOT-MEASURED;ui app-shell typecheck 交 CI。
4. **接受的偏差**:dev 原报 `Metadata-protocol: none` / patch,被 `Check Changeset` 以 authorable-surface 分片移动拒绝;已改为 `added`、spec 与 runtime `minor`(`7edbf44b`),dev 已在卡上发更正 `6561290103`。复核两条 should-fix 记为后续，不挡落地:(1)`readBaseContributions` 字段分支应与流程分支同用 `isCodeArtifactBody` 判定(树内无实际分歧);(2)spec 注释"配对包的…从不计为 contributions"措辞过宽，仅文字。
5. **范围外去向**:第 3 项(导航)等 #27928;ui 车道注意：N-19 进行中的手写应答在本 PR 合入后须带新成员。`Skills-docs: none`(已核：无已发布 skill 讲授此应答)。
6. **落地条款**:`Clause-②: yes (widening)` + `packages/spec` 路径 ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 完整复核 PASS(`6561256710`,`Head-sha` 与现 head 一致)。`Metadata-protocol: added` ⇒ spec、runtime `minor`,与 changeset 一致(`Check Changeset` 本 head 最新一次 success;17:12Z 那次 failure 读的是旧正文)。`check-governed-merges --pr 28749`:NOT governed,271 行。落地授权，维护者原话:「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」(2026-10-25T11:35Z)。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8952f7ef8a023b69b595ed3f716c21490420756a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts + packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json, docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/api.md (the two regenerated files), and the merge commit `bad518ce` read for what it resolved

**Re-confirm of the record posted as comment 6561256710** (verdict PASS on head `7edbf44b9d7d6cd13699f7c65e03230b1a4f9ec3`). The head moved by two commits, no force-push: `bad518ce` merges `origin/main` `706ac52d` into `7edbf44b` (wip-28722-merge), and `8952f7ef` regenerates the strictness ledger and the authorable-surface shard on the merged tree. `origin/main` is `706ac52d` and the merge-base is now `706ac52d`.

### ① The net diff, read, not taken on trust

- `git diff --stat origin/main 8952f7ef`: the same 12 files, +254/−17.
